definitions.explanation: Limiting particle indicating exclusivity. Shows that something is limited to what is mentioned and nothing more.

definitions.gloss: as much as, to the extent
definitions.explanation: Indicates the full extent or amount of something, often translated as 'as much as one wants' or 'to the extent possible.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧だけ⟦{飲|の}みました→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧だけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧だけ⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please eat as much as you like.

examples.japanese: ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧だけ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please come as soon as possible.
examples.notes: できるだけ = as much as possible

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧だけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧だけ⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take as much as you want.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧だけ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧だけ⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I said as much as I wanted to say.

examples.japanese: ⟦{走|はし}れる→走る：00519_hashiru⟧だけ⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: I ran as much as I could.

notes:
GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
- Noun + だけ: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧だけ (only water)
- Verb (dictionary) + だけ: ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧だけ (just look)
- Verb (た form) + だけ: ⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧だけ (only ate)
- い-adjective + だけ: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧だけ (only expensive)
- な-adjective + な + だけ: ⟦{静|しず}かな→静か：00755_shizuka⟧だけ (only quiet)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧だけ (as much as possible)
- ⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧だけ (as much as one likes)
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧だけ (only this, just this much)
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧だけ (only that, just that much)
- 〜だけでなく (not only ~)

CONTRAST WITH しか: だけ is neutral; しか + negative emphasizes insufficiency or disappointment. ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧だけ⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (only 3 came - neutral) vs. ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (only 3 came - implying disappointment).

CONTRAST WITH ⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: だけ states a plain limit; ばかり suggests the speaker finds the limited thing excessive or one-sided. ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧だけ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (eats only meat - a neutral fact) vs. ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (eats nothing but meat - implying too much).
